actual_result.theorem: Uniformly for fixed t0>0 and t0≤t≤T_N=o(sqrtN), I_micro,N(t)=c_*^2 tanh^2(t/2)/(2N)+O((1+t)N^−3/2+(1+t)^2 N^−2). Thus t_N→infinity and t_N=o(sqrtN) implies N I→c_*^2/2.
actual_result.finite_certificate: Host directed Arb at N5000,wait4 gives CMI∈[.0000970571116858,.000250353452234] nats. Lower/old wait1/3 upper>22.08.
actual_result.cost_comparison: For cycle cost2t plus identical independent stationary preparation/readout overhead≥0, certified information per cycle time improves>1.84 against wait1/3. This is not an achievable channel capacity.
actual_result.design: Leading microscopic CMI/(2t) root sinh t=2t≈2.177318985. Boundary leading CMI root t=1−e^−2t≈.796812130; boundary CMI/(2t) root4t=3(1−e^−2t)≈.437108733.
actual_result.diagnostic: Float64 N I((logN)/2)≈.230179,.364868,.478890 for N200,800,3200; analytical correlation-error budgets contain observations. These are not interval or asymptotic proofs.
